offering_description.value: The company collects, treats, distributes and sells water for households, businesses, municipalities, industrial users and fire protection. It owns and operates regulated water and wastewater utilities and runs water and wastewater systems under contract for municipal and private clients.

quotes.quote: Incorporated as a water utility Middlesex Water Company provides a full range of regulated and non-regulated water, wastewater utility and related services primarily in New Jersey and Delaware. Middlesex Water engages in collecting, treating, distributing and selling water for domestic, commercial, municipal, industrial and fire protection purposes.

Middlesex Water Company’s corporate profile includes ownership and operation of regulated water utility and wastewater systems in New Jersey and Delaware. The Company also operates water and wastewater systems under contract on behalf of municipal and private clients in New Jersey and Delaware. Middlesex Water has grown from a single water utility to an enterprise with distinct business operating units meeting a full range of residential, commercial, and municipal water and wastewater needs.
